question: Which of the following awards did Amitabh Bachchan receive on 19 March 2021?

options.text: International Federation of Film Archives (FIAF) award
Stardust 'International Icon of the Year' Award

solution:
The correct answer is the __**International Federation of Film Archives (FIAF) award. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bollywood actor Amitabh Bachchan was honoured with the International Federation of Film Archives (FIAF) Award 2021.**
 
• The virtual ceremony was held on March 19. Bachchan shared a heartwarming message after he received the award.
 
• In the lengthy message, the 'Chehre' actor also, as they conferred the award.
 
• **Amitabh is the first Indian to receive the award** for his contribution to the preservation of and access to the world`s film heritage for the benefit of present and future generations. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****FIAF Award**

 
• Once a year, FIAF celebrates a film personality whose experience and personal commitment in the field of cinema underlines the missions of the Federation, by presenting them with a FIAF Award.
 
• The FIAF Award recognizes in particular, their dedication and contribution to the preservation of, and access to, the world film heritage, for the pleasure of today’s audiences, as well as for the benefit of future generations.
 
• The FIAF Award is usually presented at an official ceremony organized during one of the major film festivals or, if relevant, a FIAF Congress.
 
• The trophy itself is a silver film can be made by Talleres de los Ballesteros in Mexico, with the help of the Filmoteca de la UNAM.
